messages:
Oncall Bot: ALERT: model-load-failure detected in us-west-2 cluster. 70% of requests to model redwood-x-13b failing at warmup. Paging on-call.
Alice M: I'm on it. seeing repeated OOMs on warmup workers, containers in CrashLoopBackOff.
Ben T: I can repro on a dev replica. stacktrace shows CUDA OOM then a deserialization error. posting logs.
Alice M: paste logs
Ben T: ```
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] ERROR warmup_runner: allocate_buffer failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] WARN model_loader: deserialize_tensor failed: DeserializationError: unexpected EOF while reading tensor metadata
[2026-03-15T02:10:15Z] ERROR compile_cache: compile timed out after 60s for aten::matmul
[2026-03-15T02:10:17Z] CRITICAL container: process exited with code OOMKilled
```
SRE Lead: That matches the metrics - GPU mem near 100% during warmup. compile cache spikes on node that just got restarted.
Carla P: Customer Success reporting elevated error rate for two enterprise tenants. Any ETA for mitigation?
Alice M: Short term: I'm going to pause warmup on new model replicas and route live traffic to fallback variant (redwood-x-7b-quant) while we investigate.
Deploy Bot: routing rule applied -> traffic: redwood-x-13b -> redwood-x-7b-quant (canary) :thumbsup:
Ben T: Confirmed fallback reduces failures for inference path, but customers report degraded latency/quality. Not ideal but mitigates outages.
Alice M: Next, trying to repro deserialization locally. suspecting corrupted checkpoint blob during S3 stream/partial multipart upload.
Ben T: I found a reproducible path: if a model shard download is truncated, deserializer raises that error, then kernel compile gets weird shapes and times out.
SRE Lead: Could be coupled with compile cache eviction thrash on that node. Are nodes running background evictions? Any recent infra changes?
Alice M: Yes, auto-eviction policy changed yesterday to be more aggressive. Rolling back eviction policy on affected node group now.
Carla P: Please add an incident note for CS: tenants A & B impacted, fallback applied, ETA unknown. I'll notify them of degraded service and mitigation.
Oncall Bot: NOTE: handoff in 30m to night on-call @Ben T. Add updates to this thread.
Ben T: Trying two mitigations in parallel:
- Restarting warmup workers with reduced concurrency (workers_per_node=2)
- Increasing model load timeout and compile timeout to 180s
Alice M: Command I'm running to restart warmup with lower concurrency:
```
kubectl patch deployment warmup-runner -n inference --patch '\nspec:\n  template:\n    spec:\n      containers:\n      - name: warmup\n        env:\n        - name: WARMUP_CONCURRENCY\n          value: "2"\n'
```
Ben T: Updated compile timeout in config-map and rolled forward. Watching logs.
[minutes pass]
Ben T: compile_timeout bump avoided the timeout but now see persistent deserialize errors on 3 shards. suspect bad objects in GCS mirror.
Alice M: If shards are corrupted, we should try re-fetching from primary S3 and verify checksums before load. Initiating object revalidate + re-download.
SRE Lead: I've drained two affected nodes and cordoned them. Recreated pods on healthy nodes with cleared compile cache.
Deploy Bot: revalidation job started for model redwood-x-13b: job/validate-model-1878001
Carla P: CS: telling customers we're doing root-cause and will provide timeline. They asked if their serves were retried; confirm yes, they saw fallback route.
Oncall Bot: Update: incident severity = SEV2. Impact: degraded quality and higher latency for some enterprise tenants; no data exfiltration.
Ben T: Revalidation found 1 corrupted shard object - re-uploading a corrected snapshot now. After upload, triggering rolling model reload.
Alice M: After reload on a healthy node and warmup with reduced concurrency + compile timeout, model loaded cleanly. No OOMs. Promoting back to small percentage of traffic.
Deploy Bot: routing rule updated -> 20% to redwood-x-13b, 80% to fallback variant.
Carla P: CS informed. Customers appreciated the quick fallback but want postmortem and RCA.
SRE Lead: Action items captured: (1) add checksum validation to streaming deserializer, (2) make compile timeout adaptive, (3) revert aggressive eviction policy until we validate behavior, (4) add canary to model uploads to prevent corrupted snapshots.
Alice M: I'll start the postmortem doc and link eval diffs for quality regression. Assigning owners in the doc.
Ben T: Handing off to night on-call. If traffic spikes or new OOMs appear escalate to infra lead.
Oncall Bot: Handoff: from Alice M to Ben T at 1878001440. All updates should be appended here. :wave:
Customer Success: Please ping us when full capacity restored so we can notify customers and lift mitigations.
SRE Lead: Thanks team. Marking incident as active -> investigation. We'll update within 1h or on significant changes.
